label: Cyberpunk RED — Night Market (Open, Browse, Sell, Buy, Haggle, Close)

room.name: Night Market — Kabuki Alley
room.desc: Folding tables and salvaged display cases line the narrow passage between two collapsing buildings. Bare bulbs string from balcony to balcony overhead. The smell of fried protein and machine oil. Vendors pack up fast when the wrong kind of attention shows up — everyone here knows the drill.

_state.shortdesc: Tall woman, chrome arm, eyes that price everything.
_state.desc: Rogue hasn't gotten where she is by being careless. The chrome arm is old but functional — custom work, not street-grade. She keeps her back to the wall and her options open. You get the impression every item on her table was liberated from somewhere it didn't belong.

_state.shortdesc: Edgerunner in a scuffed jacket, eyes moving.
_state.desc: V circles the stalls without touching anything — the universal sign of someone who knows how markets like this work. She's got eddies and a list. The question is whether the fixer has what she needs.

steps.sub: Rogue Opens Her Stand and Posts Listings

steps.note: Rogue (Fixer rank 9) opens a named Night Market and posts three items. The 8-char listing IDs appear after each sell.

steps.label: Rogue opens a named Night Market
post a Trauma Team card — premium tier
post a cred chip — expensive tier

steps.note: V (Fixer rank 5) opens her own stall in the same room. Two vendors competing side-by-side — both stalls visible in the area browse.

steps.label: V opens her own Night Market (rank 5 req)

steps.note: With two active stalls in the room, +market/browse shows the area overview: both stands, fixer names, tiers, and item counts. Enter a specific stall by name.
+market/all shows every listing from every active stall in the room, sorted alphabetically by item name. Same item from different vendors appears together for easy price comparison.

steps.label: all 5 listings from both stalls — sorted by name

steps.note: In live play: copy a listing ID from +market/browse and use +market/haggle <id>. V (rank 5) gets 15% off on success; Rogue (rank 9) would get 20%. The updated price persists in the listing. The error below shows what happens with a bad ID.

steps.label: error — bad listing ID shows clean feedback

steps.note: In live play: +market/buy <id> deducts EB from buyer and credits seller immediately. Listing is removed. The error below shows what happens with a bad ID.

steps.label: error — bad listing ID shows clean feedback

steps.note: +market/close deactivates the stall and destroys the in-world stall object. Each fixer closes their own.
Midnight Market requires Fixer rank 9+. Signals access to premium and very_expensive inventory unavailable at a standard Night Market.

steps.label: Rogue opens a named Midnight Market (rank 9 req)
browse the Midnight Market — auto-stocked with high-tier items

steps.note: Rogue locks her stand to fixer-rank+ players. V (rank 5 fixer) can enter since she passes 'connected fixer+'. A non-fixer would see the stall hidden or as <dark> if staff. +market/lock open clears it.

steps.label: V (fixer) can still enter — passes lock

steps.note: Double-open attempt, browsing with no active market, and V trying Midnight Market without rank 9 all return clean errors.

steps.label: V tries to open a second stall — error: already have one open
no active market in this room — error
V (rank 5) tries Midnight Market — error: rank 9 required
